text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I are going home after a day out when we somehow get lost.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Umm, did I majorly mess up? I'm not sure how to get back to a road I know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I can't believe we ended up in this trouble just because I tried to take a detour!
choice_data_list: Let's check the map on our phones!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer! There's a better way to get out of a situation like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer! There's a better way to get out of a situation like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: See, look over there. Let's ask the police officer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Sorry to bother you, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After asking for directions at the police box, we make it back to familiar ground.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, that settles that! I'm so glad I asked the officer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hear you can easily look up a map using your phone, but it's better to ask someone, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It also lets me stay true to what my father taught me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: He said there's no shame in asking for help when you need it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No matter how great you are, you can't do everything by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: If you try to handle all your problems alone, you might get stuck…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So to avoid that, make it a point to connect with others. That's what he told me.
choice_data_list: That's a good attitude to have.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it? It makes me happy to hear you say so.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's not just about relying on someone or having them rely on you, it's about supporting each other…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hope we can have that kind of relationship too.
choice_data_list: I'll work hard to be as dependable as I can be.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I already think you're a very dependable person, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I already think you're a very dependable person, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You always help me so much in my training and the big races.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Above all, it's thanks to you that I'm able to run so happily. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Above all, it's thanks to you that I'm able to run so happily. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I have to admit—you're like a reliable big brother to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I have to admit—you're like a reliable big sister to me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You can wear my seal of approval with pride! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel both pride and joy welling up in my heart at Maruzensky's words.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so glad! ♪ It's very encouraging to hear you say so.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always want to be there for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always want to be there for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're a hard worker, but sometimes you push yourself a little too hard.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But everything will be fine as long as we're there to support each other!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So let's work together—not just as Umamusume and trainer, but as a team! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right! As partners! ♪ Now and forever!
